text:
Alex: quick async — can someone run a tight microbench comparing funcall overhead for streaming vs sync when using structured output? need numbers + traces for the perf PR.
Priya: +1. recommend: redwood-v1-small, seq=256 prompt+64 gen, batch=1 and batch=8, 100 iters each. measure p50/p95 and end-to-end token latency. also capture serializer time.
Jon: I can run this today. will try both --funcall and --streaming flags and then add structured serializer on top. command i'll use:
```
./bench_client --model redwood-v1-small --prompt-len 256 --gen-len 64 --iters 100 --batch 1 --flags "--funcall" > out_sync.txt
./bench_client --model redwood-v1-small --prompt-len 256 --gen-len 64 --iters 100 --batch 1 --flags "--funcall --streaming" > out_stream.txt
```
Sam: capture tracer spans too: set ENV REDWOOD_TRACING=1 and use --trace-file. also enable KV cache metrics.
Casey: for structured output, add the JSON schema runner: --serializer structured_v2. that tends to add ~10-40ms depending on allocation. include both with and without serializer.
Jon: ran quick pass (batch=1, seq=320 total):
- sync funcall w/o serializer: p50 128ms, p95 210ms
- streaming funcall w/o serializer: p50 165ms, p95 280ms
- sync funcall WITH structured_v2: p50 150ms, p95 240ms
- streaming funcall WITH structured_v2: p50 190ms, p95 320ms
These are rough, noisy (100 iters). attaching traces next.
Priya: that's helpful. can you also run batch=8? we care about throughput/cost tradeoffs.
Jon: running batch=8 now, should post numbers in ~10m.
infra-bot: perf-runner job submitted: job_id=perf-1856-42, image=bench:v2026-03, region=us-west-2. logs at /perf/jobs/perf-1856-42/logs (will be populated).
Sam: for profiling, capture `--alloc-trace` + `--flamegraph` and keep `--kv-stats` on. flamegraphs will show serializer hotspots.
Casey: note: when streaming we saw work on the encode/path that serializes the toolcall object into chunks — that design adds overhead at chunk boundaries. include chunk-size metric.
Alex: plan: Jon posts full numbers + artifacts (flamegraphs + traces) here. Priya will add a small test to nightly bench harness to catch regressions. Sam/Casey to review traces and suggest optimizations. i'll ping for code review once Jon attaches artifacts.
Jon: uploaded artifacts: flamegraph: s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/perf-1856-42/flame.svg (placeholder), trace: s3://redwood-perf/artifacts/perf-1856-42/trace.json. key commit tested: a1b2c3d.
Priya: thanks — i'll draft the bench PR checklist: exact flags, commit, raw output files, summary table, and hypothesis about serializer cost.
Alex: please @sam @casey on the PR. if we see >20% p95 regression for streaming+serializer we fail the rollout.
Sam: will look once PR is up. initial glance — seems like serializer adds ~15% p50 and ~20-30% p95 for streaming. might be memory alloc heavy.
Jon: quick note — disabling per-token allocate reduces streaming+serializer p95 by ~40ms. will add alloc-free branch test.
Casey: nice. if that holds, we can push a small change to structured_v2 to reuse buffers.
Alex: cool — thanks everyone. I'll follow up in PR. :thumbsup:
